title: A paid online plan that could not be applied is invisible to the owner
what: When the owner pays MettleUp online but the payment cannot become a plan (amount differs, or the gym changed plan meanwhile), the money is kept and only MettleUp HQ gets a 'payments to check' line. The owner's billing card shows nothing: no 'payment received, being checked' line, no refund note. Any error loading billing also hides the whole card silently.
expected: The owner sees that the payment arrived, that it is being checked, and what happens next (plan or refund).
how_often: each payment that does not match or cannot be applied
fix_line: Show a 'payment received, being checked' line on the owner's billing card for any checked-but-not-applied payment

title: Owner card says support looks only with the owner's permission, but HQ can open it alone
what: The owner's 'MettleUp access' card says support can look at the records only when the owner lets them. The server also lets HQ open read access on its own in an emergency (up to 1 hour), which the privacy page admits. The owner's own screen states the narrower promise.
expected: The owner's card says the same as the privacy page: the owner can let support look, and in an emergency MettleUp can open it for up to an hour, always listed here.
how_often: every time the card is read
fix_line: Add the emergency case to the card's two sentences

title: Member messages and trainer questions are not deleted after 180 days as the privacy page says
what: The privacy page says gym messages and trainer questions are kept 180 days after the last line. In the code they are deleted only when that member or that gym next opens the list. The nightly clean-up does not touch them. A member who stops using the app at a gym that stops reading keeps those messages on the server with no end.
expected: A nightly job deletes them at 180 days for everyone, whether or not anyone opens the list.
who: members who wrote to their gym or trainer
how_often: every thread whose member and gym both stop opening the list
fix_line: Add the 180-day deletes to the nightly clean-up

title: Nobody can see whether a message's phone pop-up reached members
what: The every-minute sender counts sent, failed and gone phones only in the cloud log. A phone that fails because of a network error is not tried again (the list moves past it), and a job more than 6 hours late is closed as 'late' and never sent. The owner has no screen that says how many phones got the pop-up or why some did not.
expected: Each message shows how many phones got the pop-up, how many failed, and if it was skipped as late; failed phones are tried again once.
who: owners who send messages and offers; their members
fix_line: Save sent/failed/late counts per message where the owner can read them, and retry failed phones once

title: Phone pop-up delivery depends on the phone and cannot be proven in the cloud
what: Member pop-ups go through Google's push service to a single 'gym messages' channel. Whether they ring or show depends on the phone maker's battery and banner rules and on the member's channel setting, which the server never learns.
expected: Checked on real phones (at least one Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo and one Pixel): pop-up shows with the app closed, with the phone idle for an hour, and after the member muted the channel.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check
fix_line: Run the real-phone check and record the result per phone maker

title: An unanswered member message vanishes from the gym's list after 90 days
what: The gym's list and waiting count show only threads from the last 90 days, but threads are kept 180 days and the member still sees theirs as waiting. A message the gym never answered silently drops off the gym's side.
expected: An unanswered message stays in the gym's list and count until it is answered or deleted.
who: owners and staff; members waiting for a reply
how_often: any message left unanswered for more than 90 days
fix_line: Keep unanswered threads in the gym list regardless of age

title: Bring-a-friend setting promises free days that only arrive if the owner taps
what: After saving, the setting says a member gets N free days for each friend who joins. In fact the days are added only when the owner taps 'Give free days' on the friend's enquiry. When front-desk staff turn the enquiry into a member, no prompt appears and nobody is reminded.
expected: The words say the owner adds the days with one tap from the friend's enquiry, and the owner is reminded when a referred friend joins.
who: owners; members who brought a friend
how_often: every referred friend added by staff
fix_line: Change the saved line and add a Today reminder for unrewarded referred joins

title: Cancel membership button stays grey with no reason shown
what: In 'Cancel this membership?' the red button stays greyed until the reason has 3 letters. The box hint does not say a reason is needed, so the owner sees a dead button.
expected: A line next to the button or under the box says 'Write a short reason to cancel'.
fix_line: Say the reason is needed under the box

title: Add buttons go grey at their limit with no reason
what: 'Add a machine' (30), '+ Add a meal' (meal limit) and '+ Add a special day' (30) grey out at their limit with no words saying a limit was reached.
expected: A short line says the limit, e.g. 'Up to 30 machines'.
fix_line: Show the limit next to each button when reached

title: Setup ticks and new-feature dots are kept in one browser only
what: Hand-ticked 'Set up your gym' steps and the 'new' dots are saved in this browser. On the owner's phone after using the laptop, the same steps show as not done and the same features show as new again.
expected: The marks follow the owner across devices (saved on the server), or the page says they are per device.
who: owners using more than one device
fix_line: Store the ticks and seen dots with the gym's settings

title: Old brand name saved into the support-access record the owner reads
what: Support access records are saved with the name 'ForgeAI support' and the reason 'The gym asked ForgeAI support to look'. The owner's access list reads these records; if it shows the name or reason, the owner sees the old brand.
expected: New records say MettleUp; old records are shown under the current name.
how_often: every support look, if the panel shows the stored words (panel side not in this folder)
fix_line: Write MettleUp in new records and map the old name when shown
